subject: docs: align 1.3.0 documentation and command JSON with the implementation (#1735)
reason: The change touches only documentation (Markdown files under docs/ and the top-level COMMANDS.md, COMPATIBILITY.md, README.md, QUICK_START.md) and the src/commands/*.json command-description files. Those JSON files are not referenced by the build or by any source file: they are doc metadata, not loaded at runtime, so the module binary built at the change behaves identically to the parent's. There is no behavior to exercise or compare, so no scenario is needed.
